# Mattia Ippoliti

> Personal site and portfolio of Mattia Ippoliti, a software engineer in Rome, Italy, building digital products, data-driven interfaces, and web applications.

## Pages

- [Home](https://mattia.app/): who Mattia is and what he does
- [About](https://mattia.app/about/): experience, skills, and approach to digital product work
- [Work](https://mattia.app/work/): selected software engineering, interaction, and data projects
- [Ciao!](https://mattia.app/work/ciao/): software collective co-founded by Mattia, building digital products for partners end to end
- [Surveys AI Platform](https://mattia.app/work/ciao-surveys/): personality and beliefs survey platform with 181 prompts and trait dashboards across NEO, HEXACO and MPQ
- [Ciele](https://mattia.app/work/ciele/): self-hostable platform for AI Teammates that answer from an organization's own knowledge
- [Accomplishments](https://mattia.app/accomplishments/): certifications and milestones
- [Contact](https://mattia.app/contact/): how to get in touch
